outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 3,884 women registered at a midwife-led unit (MLU) in Ireland
finding: Midwife-led care was associated with a low rate of complications during labor and birth and could be a safe option for a large proportion of healthy pregnant women.
mod_finding: Women in MLU had a higher rate of spontaneous vaginal birth and lower rates of amniotomy and episiotomy compared to women in consultant-led care.
